Let \(p=2012\). From the vertex-root conditions:
\[
g(-a/2)=0 \implies d=\frac{ac}{2}-\frac{a^2}{4},
\]
\[
f(-c/2)=0 \implies b=\frac{ac}{2}-\frac{c^2}{4}.
\]
Then the equal-minimum condition is automatically satisfied:
\[
b-\frac{a^2}{4}=d-\frac{c^2}{4}=\frac{ac}{2}-\frac{a^2+c^2}{4}.
\]

At the intersection point, \(f(p)=g(p)\), so
\[
0=f(p)-g(p)=(a-c)p+(b-d).
\]
Using \(b-d=\frac{a^2-c^2}{4}=\frac{(a-c)(a+c)}{4}\),
\[
0=(a-c)\left(p+\frac{a+c}{4}\right).
\]
Since the polynomials are distinct, \(a\neq c\). Therefore
\[
p+\frac{a+c}{4}=0
\]
so
\[
a+c=-4p=-4(2012)=-8048.
\]
\[
\boxed{-8048}
\]
